{{Quote|Her name is Narlissa. I want you to get her out of there if you can. She was very kind to me while I was in there. She healed me when I mouthed off to the guards and gave me part of her rations when mine were cut.|[[Bannoc G'noc]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:LL" />}}
'''Narlissa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I'm sorry. They killed her right before I arrived. I found her in the termination rooms. [...] I found her journal. Her last entry was about you. [...] She said she did the things she did because she loved you.|A spacer, to Bannoc G'noc|<ref name="SWG:LL" />}}
By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Narlissa was captured by the [[Corellian slavers]] and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] in the [[Corellian Slaver Bunker]] near [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]]. During her captivity, she met the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] man [[Bannoc G'noc]] and both became lovers.<ref name="SWG:LL" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Bannoc finally managed to escape the bunker with a group of slaves led by [[Kyran Silene]]. However, Narlissa remained captive. The escaped slaves did not reach Tyrena and established a camp in the wilderness.<ref name="SWG:LL" /> A spacer recruited by Kyran Silene's [[Madison Silene|wife]] later arrived at the camp.<ref name="SWG:TtB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Talk to Bandor|Corellia}}</ref> The spacer planed to infiltrate the bunker to find evidence of the slaver operations for the [[Corellian Security Force]].<ref name="SWG:IE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Incriminating Evidence|Corellia}}</ref> The spacer also met Bannoc G'noc and agreed to rescue Narlissa while going to the bunker. Unfortunately, Narlissa was executed by the slavers in the meanwhile. Once in the bunker, the spacer reached the detentions cells with the help of a guard who felt deeply guilty for working with the slavers. The spacer eventually found the body of Narlissa and brought her personal diary to Bannoc G'noc.<ref name="SWG:LL" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommonerFemale.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of Narlissa]]
[[File:Narlissa.jpg|150px|thumb|Randomly generated depiction of Narlissa]]
Narlissa was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:LL" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Narlissa was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
